name: sidebar-browser
description: An open-source browser in the spirit of Arc: tabs in a vertical sidebar, Spaces, Peek, Split View and auto-archive.
author: Rektoooooo

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/sidebar.css dist/web/renderer/ && cp src/overlay/overlay.html src/overlay/overlay.css dist/web/overlay/ && mkdir -p dist/web/onboarding && cp src/onboarding/onboarding.html src/onboarding/onboarding.css src/onboarding/intro.html src/onboarding/intro.css dist/web/onboarding/ && cp -R src/onboarding/browser-logos dist/web/onboarding/ && cp src/little/little.html src/little/little.css dist/web/little/ && cp src/pip/pip.html src/pip/pip.css dist/web/pip/ && cp src/corner/corner.html src/corner/corner.css dist/web/corner/ && mkdir -p dist/web/crash dist/web/status && cp src/crash/crash.html src/crash/crash.css dist/web/crash/ && cp src/status/status.html src/status/status.css dist/web/status/
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node e2e/check-app.mjs && node e2e/check-overlay.mjs && node e2e/check-extensions.mjs && node e2e/permission-check.mjs && node e2e/check-google-sign-in.mjs && node e2e/check-motion.mjs && node e2e/check-live-folders.mjs && node e2e/check-performance.mjs && node e2e/check-windows.mjs && node e2e/check-tab-sleep.mjs && node e2e/check-backup.mjs && node e2e/check-sync.mjs && node e2e/check-privacy.mjs && node e2e/check-passwords.mjs && node e2e/check-onboarding.mjs
